name: 57 - Core - Human Handoff Orchestrator - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::BIGINT AS session_id,
        $3::BIGINT AS message_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS mobile,
        $5::TEXT AS urgency,
        $6::TEXT AS reason,
        NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') AS patient_message,
        $8::JSONB AS risk_flags
),

handoff_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,

        session.id AS session_id,
        COALESCE(
            session.patient_id,
            mobile_patient.id
        ) AS patient_id,

        message.id AS message_id,
        message.content_text,

        COALESCE(
            request.patient_message,
            message.content_text
        ) AS patient_message,

        request.mobile,
        request.urgency,
        request.reason,
        request.risk_flags,

        CASE
            WHEN (
                session.collected_entities ->> 'appointment_id'
            ) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN (
                    session.collected_entities ->> 'appointment_id'
                )::BIGINT
            ELSE NULL
        END AS appointment_id,

        CASE request.urgency
            WHEN 'urgent'
                THEN NOW()

            WHEN 'high'
                THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'

            WHEN 'normal'
                THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '4 hours'

            ELSE NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day'
        END AS due_at

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN conversation_sessions session
        ON session.id = request.session_id
       AND session.clinic_id = clinic.id

    INNER JOIN conversation_messages message
        ON message.id = request.message_id
       AND message.session_id = session.id

    LEFT JOIN patients mobile_patient
        ON mobile_patient.clinic_id = clinic.id
       AND mobile_patient.mobile = request.mobile

    LIMIT 1
),

upserted_task AS (
    INSERT INTO human_handoff_tasks (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        appointment_id,
        task_type,
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        priority,
        status,
        reason,
        due_at
    )

    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.appointment_id,
        'conversation_handoff',
        'conversation_message',
        context.message_id,
        context.urgency,
        'open',

        CONCAT(
            context.reason,
            CASE
                WHEN context.patient_message IS NOT NULL
                    THEN CONCAT(
                        ' پیام بیمار: ',
                        context.patient_message
                    )
                ELSE ''
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(
                    context.risk_flags
                ) > 0
                    THEN CONCAT(
                        ' پرچم‌های ریسک: ',
                        context.risk_flags::TEXT
                    )
                ELSE ''
            END
        ),

        context.due_at

    FROM handoff_context context

    ON CONFLICT (
        source_type,
        source_record_id,
        task_type
    )
    WHERE source_record_id IS NOT NULL

    DO UPDATE SET
        priority = CASE
            WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'urgent'
                THEN 'urgent'

            WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'high'
             AND human_handoff_tasks.priority IN (
                    'low',
                    'normal'
                 )
                THEN 'high'

            WHEN EXCLUDED.priority = 'normal'
             AND human_handoff_tasks.priority = 'low'
                THEN 'normal'

            ELSE human_handoff_tasks.priority
        END,

        reason = EXCLUDED.reason,

        due_at = LEAST(
            COALESCE(
                human_handoff_tasks.due_at,
                EXCLUDED.due_at
            ),
            EXCLUDED.due_at
        ),

        status = CASE
            WHEN human_handoff_tasks.status = 'cancelled'
                THEN 'open'
            ELSE human_handoff_tasks.status
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING *
),

updated_message AS (
    UPDATE conversation_messages message

    SET
        tool_action = CASE
            WHEN context.urgency = 'urgent'
                THEN 'urgent_human_handoff'
            ELSE 'human_handoff'
        END,

        tool_result =
            COALESCE(
                message.tool_result,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'handoff',
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'handoff_task_id',
                        task.id,

                    'priority',
                        task.priority,

                    'status',
                        task.status,

                    'due_at',
                        task.due_at,

                    'reason',
                        task.reason,

                    'created_at',
                        task.created_at
                )
            )

    FROM handoff_context context

    CROSS JOIN upserted_task task

    WHERE message.id = context.message_id
      AND message.session_id = context.session_id

    RETURNING message.id
),

updated_session AS (
    UPDATE conversation_sessions session

    SET
        patient_id = COALESCE(
            session.patient_id,
            context.patient_id
        ),

        status = 'waiting_human',

        pending_action = CASE
            WHEN context.urgency = 'urgent'
                THEN 'urgent_human_handoff'
            ELSE 'human_handoff'
        END,

        risk_flags = context.risk_flags,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM handoff_context context

    WHERE session.id = context.session_id

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM updated_message
      )

    RETURNING
        session.id,
        session.status,
        session.pending_action
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM handoff_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_task
        )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM handoff_context
        )
            THEN 'conversation_context_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_task
            WHERE priority = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'urgent_handoff_created'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_task
        )
            THEN 'human_handoff_created'

        ELSE 'human_handoff_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM handoff_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک، مکالمه یا پیام مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_task
            WHERE priority = 'urgent'
        )
            THEN 'ارجاع فوری انسانی ایجاد و در صف قرار گرفت.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM upserted_task
        )
            THEN 'ارجاع انسانی ایجاد و در صف پیگیری قرار گرفت.'

        ELSE 'ارجاع انسانی ایجاد نشد.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upserted_task
    ) AS handoff_task_id,

    (
        SELECT priority
        FROM upserted_task
    ) AS priority,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM upserted_task
    ) AS handoff_status,

    (
        SELECT due_at
        FROM upserted_task
    ) AS due_at,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM handoff_context
    ) AS patient_id,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM handoff_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS session_status,

    (
        SELECT pending_action
        FROM updated_session
    ) AS pending_action,

    'compose_handoff_response'::TEXT AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## ارجاع انسانی یکپارچه

این Workflow مقصد مسیرهای `human_handoff` و `urgent_human_handoff` است.

وظایف:
- ایجاد تسک در `human_handoff_tasks`
- جلوگیری از تسک تکراری برای همان پیام
- تعیین مهلت متناسب با اولویت
- اتصال بیمار و نوبت در صورت وجود
- قراردادن مکالمه در وضعیت `waiting_human`

برای استفاده، ابتدا Workflow شماره 55 باید اجرا شده باشد.
